hypothesis.mechanism: Bound entire successor rectangles using per-process reachable-output envelopes across all remaining times, solve coarse lower/upper transport, and refine the hierarchy only where the root interval requires it. Singleton fallback recursively recovers full DP.
hypothesis.omitted_computation: Fine cross-process continuation entries inside unresolved successor rectangles; the envelope oracle uses one-process sparse reachability extrema and never scans the hidden cross matrix.
assumptions: The corrected common finite k-window model with additive costs at times1..T and an optimized initial coupling is the target
All positive-probability successors remain in the partitions; occupation is not used to delete alternatives
Reachability extrema are computed from every positive kernel edge and their preprocessing is fully counted
Block lower and upper costs enclose every fine successor-pair continuation cost; coarse upper plans use parent-specific conditional proportions when lifted
The numerical probe validates against an independent LP reference but is not an outward-rounded mathematical certificate
hypothesis.lemma_or_invariant: Pushing any fine coupling to block masses proves coarse OT on block lower envelopes is a lower bound. A coarse coupling lifted as gamma_AB*(a_i/a_A)*(b_j/b_B) preserves both fine marginals. Reachability distance extrema bound every remaining pathwise cost, so recursive lower/upper values contain the same finite-model root; exhaustive singleton refinement terminates at full DP.

hypothesis.falsification_rule: Any reference outside a reported interval or infeasible lifted marginal is implementation_invalid. If correct runs reach the requested root width but any eligible group misses either work threshold, classify performance_prediction_falsified. If relative width is undefined because the exact target is zero, or numerical interval validity cannot be audited, classify that group inconclusive and do not promote the hypothesis.

probe.oracle: Independent common_model exact_dp on T=4 scalar path models plus analytic continuation-order, product-lift, unequal-marginal and hidden-entry fixtures. Candidate never sees the reference value for refinement or stopping.
probe.cost_accounting: Count one-process reachability edge operations; envelope queries; distinct fine continuation entries materialized; distinct Bellman pair solves; all lower/upper transport arc variables including retries and fallback; policy-bound operations; hierarchy nodes; peak records; total wall time. Reference work uses a memoized exhaustive DP count. Work-count criteria do not imply speed.

hypothesis.breadth_challenge: Both costs, both process families and every original k/delta combination appear in the short-horizon screen. Passing licenses a later T=50 test; it does not substitute T=4 for the final scope.
hypothesis.ablation: Compare identical local LP primitive under exhaustive singleton DP; universal zero/global-range envelopes; and hierarchy after deterministic random permutation. Separately report static terminal-cost pruning so temporal-envelope savings are not credited to scalar geometry alone.
unresolved_objections: Reachability envelopes may be so loose that almost every rectangle refines; the probe is designed to falsify this
